what: oracle-gap decomposition across released zero-shot pipelines, full official val splits
definition: gap = oracle (best pool mask vs GT) - achieved (the pipeline's selected mask vs GT); wrong-instance when achieved < 0.5 <= oracle; wrong_instance_share is the fraction of the recoverable IoU mass in wrong-instance gaps. Every reported dataset uses the full official split n. All achieved/oracle values in this file are single-protocol (our unified official evaluator); published numbers are reported separately per pipeline in `published` and are cross-harness as labelled there.

blocked.name: TAS (Text Augmented Spatial-aware Zero-shot RIS, EMNLP Findings 2023)
blocked.reason: the released entry point requires a precomputed per-sentence overall-caption file `overall_caption_path/overall_caption_{dataset}_{split}_{splitby}.json` (tas_main.py loads it unconditionally); the repository ships neither the file nor a script that creates it, and README step 3 asks the user to prepare captions with BLIP-2. It also requires the spaCy transformer model en_core_web_trf, a torch.jit ViT-B/32 checkpoint, and SAM-H, CLIP and BLIP-2 weights; as released the pipeline is not executable without first generating the missing data file.

blocked.name: Ref-Diff (zero-shot RIS with generative models, CoRR 2023)
blocked.reason: the released test entry point loads a trained segmenter checkpoint `best_model.pth` from the output directory, but no released checkpoint is provided: the config's `resume` is empty, the repository's pretrain/ contains only a 2.9 MB stego head, and the README quick start assumes a previous training run. It additionally needs checkpoints/sam_vit_h_4b8939.pth and checkpoints/v1-5-pruned.ckpt, neither shipped.

blocked.name: Global-Local exact FreeSOLO-pool run (Seonghoon-Yu/Zero-shot-RIS)
blocked.reason: the released pipeline's original proposal pool is FreeSOLO R101. The README weight URL (cloudstor.aarnet.edu.au/plus/s/V8C0onE5H63x3RD/download) does not resolve from this host (curl exit/status 000); the repo vendors only a FreeSOLO config and imports detectron2, and the FreeSOLO model code is not included. The released selector itself is runnable and is reported on the SAM ViT-H pool under the full-pipeline entry.

verdict: Across the released HybridGL pipeline, the GLOD-RIS reimplementation and the Global-Local selector, wrong-instance selection carries the large majority of the recoverable oracle gap on every dataset (HybridGL 94.0/94.2/91.8%, GLOD-RIS 93.3/93.7/91.8%, Global-Local 95.1/94.2/92.5%). The MaskCLIP value-map adaptation is the contrast: its own component pool caps the oracle at 25.2/28.1/31.8 mIoU with wrong-instance shares 24.3/27.3/31.6%, so its gap is pool-limited; the same dense map on the shared SAM pool selects 8.2/9.8/11.6 mIoU and is wrong-instance dominated (96.7/96.3/95.2%). The diagnosis therefore replicates where a good pool exists and identifies the pool as the limit where it does not. The exact Global-Local FreeSOLO pool, TAS and Ref-Diff are documented as blocked with their reasons.
